summary: Ohmyhome Ltd (Singapore) filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Mr. Agus Prasetyo as Acting CFO, effective April 23, 2026, approved by the Board and Nomination Committee. Prasetyo, previously CEO since January 2026, continues as CEO while overseeing financial operations during the transition. No terms, price, premiums, advisors, or structural details are disclosed as this is a routine management appointment. The filing does not involve a special situation transaction; it is an ordinary corporate governance update. Watch for any further changes in executive leadership or financial reporting implications.
